seo.title: Multilingual Restaurant Website — Menu in 25+ Languages | IQ Rest
seo.description: Your restaurant website and QR menu in 25+ languages. Guests switch languages with one tap — menu, contacts, and reservations adapt instantly.

hero.title: Your Restaurant Website in 25+ Languages
hero.subtitle: Tourists and international guests see your menu in their own language. One tap to switch — everything adapts instantly: dishes, descriptions, contacts, navigation.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required. Free plan available.

features.title: How Multilingual Support Works
features.subtitle: Speak your customer's language without any extra work.

items.title: Guests Choose Their Language
items.description: A language selector appears on your menu. Guests tap their preferred language, and the entire website — menu, descriptions, contact info, navigation — switches instantly. No page reload needed.

items.title: Add Languages from Your Dashboard
items.description: Enable new languages with one click. Use AI translation to fill in the content, or enter translations manually. Each language can be toggled on or off independently.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about multilingual menus.

items.question: How many languages can I add to my menu?
items.answer: Up to 25+ languages including all major European languages, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Farsi, and more. Add as many as your guests need.

items.question: Do I need to translate everything manually?
items.answer: No. Use the built-in AI translation to translate your entire menu with one click. You can also edit any translation manually for full control.

items.question: Does the language preference get saved?
items.answer: Yes. When a guest selects a language, it's remembered for their next visit. They don't need to choose again when they return.

items.question: Is multilingual support available on the free plan?
items.answer: The free plan includes up to 2 languages. Basic and Pro plans offer unlimited languages with AI translation included.
